serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: Hello there!
Why is he so upbeat? This can’t be good.
You: Hello. Mr. Landlord.
Now that I think about it… Why do I always call him “Landlord”. 
I mean, he has a name… What was it again? Agnus? Archie? Alfred? No, no, no. This can’t be right… 
What was it again…
…
Damn. I can’t remember. I’ve called him landlord for so long I completely forgot…
It’d be embarrassing to ask him now.
Landlord: Deep in thought, huh? Inaction like this is why so many young males nowadays are in trouble.
Landlord: Deep, deep trouble. 
Landlord: Not enough money to pay rent, no women, no money.
He mentioned money twice.
Landlord: You ain’t getting any younger, boy. 
You: Okay, okay. Enough of this sermon. Where are you going with this?
Landlord: Impatience is another sin the new generations struggle with… I swear it’s the internet’s fault…
You: …
You: I have somewhere to go. I’m going to go now.
He blocked me with his wide body.
#landlord.animate(MoveToLeft)
Landlord: Let’s cut to the chase. I have a great business opportunity for you.
You: Business opportunity? What do you mean?
Landlord: Your neighbours…{{wi}} I mean the people that live in the apartment directly behind yours, on the other side of the wall. 
Landlord: You see, they had some troubles with paying their rent on time…
Landlord: They kept whining: “It’s too muuuuuuch! Please just a biiit lower and we’d be able to pay. Please have mercy, I have little kids~”
Landlord: I’m a very generous person, so I’ve decided to lower their rent by 10%. 
You: Just like that?
Landlord: Hahahahahahahah, of course not! Do you take me for some sucker?!
Landlord: I’ve sealed their bathroom! This cut their apartment’s metrage almost in half and allowed me to lower their rent!
So he cut their rent by 10% and shrank their apartment by 50%...{{wi}} That's the landlord for you. 
With that being said, I’m a bit jealous. They had a private bathroom in the first place…
{{punch}}W-What am I thinking! A family has no bathroom now. That’s an awful situation…
You: Have they been paying on time after that?
Landlord: …
You: Is that family… {{wi}}Still living there? 
Landlord: …
You: What happened to them?!
Landlord: Do you really wanna know?
Landlord: Tenants come and go, that’s how this world works. You can’t cheat physics.{{wi}} And Money.{{wi}} Especially money.
You: …
Landlord: Anyway Anon. With my busy life I completely forgot about this sealed bathroom.
Landlord: It’s hard to find a tenant willing to pay for such a big bathroom in this area. After all, it’s pretty much a luxury these days.
Landlord: I was looking at the floor plan and I realised I’ve been losing money by not utilizing it this whole time!!!
Landlord: I still can’t believe it. I must be getting old…
Landlord: So. I want to sell you this bathroom. We can put a door in your room.
That does sound amazing. Also the word “sell”? Does that mean my rent won’t increase?
Landlord: Of course, your rent will increase as well.
Of course…
You: How much would it be?
Landlord: Hmmm… 1 million dollars?
You: WHAT!
Landlord: Come on now! I know you are keeping some on the side. Did you honestly think I wouldn’t sniff out the green ones on you?
You: I might have more money, but I’m not paying a million dollars for a bathroom!
Landlord: Tsk!
Landlord: How about 100k? You’re killing me here.
You: That’s still a lot! It’s not like you are making a new bathroom, it’s already there!
How much could possibly breaking the wall and installing a new door cost?!
Does he perhaps… need money?
For him to come to me with such an unreasonable, even for him, request… 
Do I have the upper hand in the negotiations? I mean he can’t really sell this to anyone, but me.
